# Tisha LED Walls

> Tisha LED Walls provides LED wall and LED screen rentals for events, with supporting event equipment and services in Gurugram and selected Delhi NCR locations.

## Business

- Website: https://tishaledwalls.pages.dev/
- Primary service: LED wall rental and LED screen rental for events.
- Additional enquiries: LED TV and standee rentals, stage setup, sound and PA systems, AV equipment, projector rentals, DJ services, live-band arrangements, and event decoration.
- Service area: Gurugram (Gurgaon), Delhi, Noida, and across Delhi NCR. Confirm availability for the event venue and date.
- Phone: +91 7703948857
- Email: tishaledwalls@gmail.com
- Address: 928, Jharsa Village, Sector 39, Gurugram, Haryana 122003, India

## Enquiries

Share the event date, venue or area, event type, audience size, and equipment requirements when requesting availability or a quote. Rental configuration and cost depend on the event brief, equipment, duration, transportation, venue access, and setup requirements. Confirm service availability directly with the business.
